instruction: Compare iPhone 15 Pro with iPhone 14 Pro Max and iPhone 13 Mini

metadata.explanation: Variation comparing mixed iPhone models (Pro, Pro Max, and Mini) using the same Apple comparison interface. The agent needs to navigate to the iPhone comparison page and select the three specified models: iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 14 Pro Max, and iPhone 13 Mini. Uses existing evaluator that parses the modelList parameter from the active tab URL.
metadata.verification: The expected modelList values match Apple's URL parameter format for iPhone models. Similar to the original iPhone comparison task, maintaining similar complexity and interaction pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL and parses 'modelList' query parameter
URL parsing with split_list correctly handles comma-separated model IDs in Apple's comparison URLs
Metric correctly compares lists with ignore_list_order flag, which is semantically appropriate for comparison tasks
Expected values match Apple's URL parameter format: 'iphone-15-pro', 'iphone-14-pro-max', 'iphone-13-mini'
Complete coverage: all three required iPhone models are verified
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts comparison models from URL -> metric compares list of model IDs -> expected values are accurate
